spec_atomic_units: Module top_module has inputs clk, a, and b
Module top_module has outputs q and state
Circuit is sequential with clock input clk
q is likely the output of a flip-flop
state depends on inputs and flip-flop's state
Circuit behavior is triggered by the rising edge of clk
Value of q changes only on the rising edge of clk
state changes combinatorially based on a, b, and q

Value of state depends combinatorially on a, b, and q
